claim: SEC EDGAR's company search can list every filer assigned SIC code 3674 ('Semiconductors & Related Devices'), including long-defunct and non-operating filers.

claim: SEC Regulation S-K Item 101 requires US registrants to describe their business by segment, including any dependence on key products or customers, but only to the extent material; it does not require customers to be named.
evidence: "(i) Revenue-generating activities, products and/or services, and any dependence on revenue-generating activities, key products, services, product families or customers, including governmental customers;" ... "(vi) Dependence on one or a few major customers;" ... "only information material to an understanding of the business taken as a whole is required" (17 CFR 229.101(c))
notes: The 'not required to name' part is our reading of the text, which lists dependence as a topic without a naming requirement; existing claims CLM-0167 (TSMC 'largest customer' 19%, unnamed) and CLM-0512 (AMAT 'two customers') show chip firms often disclose shares without names.
